memoryHook: Ethnisch: relating to a people (Greek ethnos).

quiz.prompt: Germany's four recognised national minorities include…
options: Danes, Frisians, Sorbs, Sinti and Roma
quiz.answer: Danes, Frisians, Sorbs, Sinti and Roma

goodToKnow: Ethnisch means ethnic: ethnische Minderheiten, ethnische Säuberung (ethnic cleansing). Germany officially recognises four national minorities: Danes, Frisians, the Sorbs (a Slavic people in Lusatia with their own language) and the German Sinti and Roma. Die Ethnie is an ethnic group. Don't confuse it with ethisch (ethical). From Greek ethnos (people).
